description.value: Karma Indian Bistro is a locally loved sit-down restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood serving authentic Indian cuisine with a modern twist — from tandoori specialties to rich curries and vegetarian dishes. The restaurant is listed on the Michelin Guide and has a heated outdoor patio for al fresco dining. Located on West 4th Avenue, a popular cycling corridor connecting central Vancouver to the waterfront.
